evidence.quote: alive and she’s ready to go and she’s ready to talk to Justin. Right, Kat? Yes, I am. So Justin, I guess the starting point, which we all want to know about is what started you gaming? What was your earliest memory that kind of set you on the track to develop a love for games? I would have to say, well, okay, so I was born in 86. And so by that point, the NES was about three years old. And my dad had an NES and the only three games that I can remember playing on there were Mario, Duck Hunt and Wild Gumbon. And Wild Gumbon was the one that I played the most. I love Wild Scatman. Such a good game. Such a good game. And then I guess obviously I played Mario 2 and 3, so, you know, five games, whatever. And after that, we got a Super Nintendo and the only games I really played on that were Super Mario World and Turtles in Time, which is possibly my all time favorite game, either that or Mario 64.
